speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced akathisia secondary to Risperidone use.

The symptoms of inner restlessness, fidgeting, and an inability to remain still are classic signs of akathisia, a common extrapyramidal side effect of antipsychotic medications like risperidone. Given your recent diagnosis and medication start, this fits the clinical picture perfectly. Do you have any other specific concerns or questions about managing this side effect?
